scenes.title: Applying to 8 universities shouldn't cost you 8 weekends.
scenes.sub: Here's how Ivyward does the work.

scenes.title: Tell us about yourself once.
scenes.body: Upload your CV and transcript. The agents read them into one profile every application draws from.

scenes.title: Then the agents:
items: Draft essays for you to approve

scenes.title: Nothing goes to a school until you sign.
scenes.body: You review every essay and every form first.
